item.title: Thunderstorm Advisory No. 2 #SLPRSD
item.description:
Thunderstorm Advisory No. 2 #SLPRSD
Issued at 04:40 AM 24 November 2026

Moderate to occasionally heavy rainshowers with lightning and strong winds are expected over #Albay(CityOfLigao, CityOfTabaco, Malilipot, Malinao, Polangui, Oas and Libon) within the next 1 to 2 hours.

The above conditions are being experienced in #Albay(Camalig, Daraga, Guinobatan, PioDuran, Jovellar, LegazpiCity, Manito, SantoDomingo, Bacacay), #Sorsogon(CityOfSorsogon, Castilla, Pilar, Donsol, Magallanes, Juban and Casiguran) which may persist within 1 to 2 hours and may affect nearby areas.

All are advised to take precautionary measures against the impacts associated with these hazards which include flash floods and landslides.

Keep monitoring for updates.
